title: Post-reset: the phone executor streams a LIVE account feed to the server (positions, venue SL/TP incl. hand-moved stops, unrealized P&L, balance/equity, day P&L), often and fast, so risk/cushion, LTR packets and the UI see the real account
roadmap_unmapped_reason: operator ask 2026-11-10; prop data-path fix, milestone assigned at planning
note: Operator 2026-11-10 ~15:55Z (voice, condensed faithfully): not today, bigger scope; after the reset. 'with the phone executor ... that should basically be a live feed, right? We have the app running all the time, looking at the account, and it should be passing that data regularly and quickly to the system. So we need to make sure that we get that ironed out after the reset.' TODAY'S SYMPTOMS (all breakout_2, one root cause: the server lacks the live account state): (1) a new ETH short refused at 15:45Z, 'risk gate: cushion_unknown (the snapshot carries no unrealized P&L, so open positions cannot be marked to their stops)'; (2) three operator hand-moves of the SOL stop (BE, then 85.5, then 82.5) never reached the journal, which still says 89.1; (3) the dashboard shows SL/TP '—' and an 'estimate' uPnL for the prop trade (PROP-UI-BRACKETS-CLOSED); (4) the LTR packet's account_bounds is empty for prop and its mechanics read 'match' while the venue differs (LTR-PACKET-FIXES); (5) prop status: balance/day_pnl/unrealized null, positions_state no_table, closed_orders_state not_read. Scope: the app reads positions + the order sheet (both brackets) + balance/equity/unrealized/day P&L from the terminal on every pass and posts them on a fixed short cadence with as_of and read_state. The server stores them as MEASURED (src/runtime/provenance.py) and records a changed venue stop via note_human_amend. The risk gate, live_review_packet and the UI read the feed, and a stale feed is an explicit read-state (never 0). Subsumes the 'app records a hand-moved stop' item on LTR-ACCOUNT-SCOPED-ACTIONS; cross-link PROP-UI-BRACKETS-CLOSED, PHONE-SCREENSHOTS, BREAKOUT-UNRECORDED. Done = breakout_2's next hand-moved stop shows in /api/bot/prop/status within one cadence, and the cushion gate computes from measured unrealized P&L. 2026-11-10 17:15Z case: the breakout_2 SOL short (prop-manual-ed6dc04db93b, 6.82 @ 87.64) was closed by the operator's hand-set stop at 82.50 on the terminal (screenshot: Long 6.82 SOL @ stop loss 82.50, Settled, order XOJL74P-RFBM5-TI7WYK; balance 4,896.14). The system did NOT see the close. Journaled by hand via system-action prop-report-close (issue #24710, run 42862346882, exit 0): ticket closed, still_listed_open false, provenance ESTIMATED, gross P&L (82.5-87.64)x6.82 short = +$35.05 before fees. Verified: /api/bot/prop/status breakout_2 open_count 0. Operator 2026-11-11 ~16:00Z: 'I haven't moved the SLs myself, but the system should at least be able to see where they are and it should be able to update them as well ... we'll have to fix that ASAP.' Live case: SOL short on tradeify_1 + velotrade_1, stops still at the original 89.105 while +2R open; three LTR reviews advised 85.35 and none could be applied. Priority: first wave after the reset, alongside the prop apply path (LTR-ACCOUNT-SCOPED-ACTIONS). Scope: read venue stops per prop account (incl. hand moves) AND an apply path for tighten/close through the phone executor, verified by read-back.
